required_before_execution.requires: Frozen exact helper/spec/descriptor/hashes, bounded measurement authority, fullrefs/ownership and valid lease; no cap reset
PID plus process birth/handle/image and observed lineage; no cache-prefix ownership or PID-only termination
Separate snapshot/First/Next return values and immediate last-error; EMPTY/PARTIAL not absence; bounded BAD_LENGTH attempts
Monotonic plus UTC, scheduled/actual start/end/gaps; post-open probe or explicit reason not_run
Actual observed module path and file identity; unknown on mismatch; no memory-integrity or causal claim from disk hash
Bounded owned-thread observations with errors/truncation/flags, raw WaitTime; observer cannot block readiness or cleanup
Owned tab final URL plus redirect/status and exact nonce fixture response bytes; CLIrc0 or empty snapshot insufficient
Named close/delete/closed-session proof and owned census; no lock release before verified cleanup; paused handoff on uncertainty
Separate startup/readiness/fullflow/observer/cleanup, child rc and shell rc; never promote unknown or skipped
Verify all ten design counterexamples with controlled fixtures before browser admission; native ABI/API proof remains separate
Exact H2/pins/Desktop/timeouts and selected mode; native fullflow proof per r3 without extra product acceptance conditions
Native retention, allowlisted summaries only, no secrets/profile dumps/global changes or unrelated process termination
